class.name: Awakened Pyromancer Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Pyromancer Class

skills.name: Heat Mastery
lore: Each Basic Attack grants 1 Heat stack. At 3 stacks, you enter Ignition.
While in Ignition, your next non-Ultimate skill is enhanced,
casting a more powerful version before consuming Ignition.
Ignition visually darkens your flames to deep crimson and
slightly intensifies burn damage.

skills.name: Pyro Combo
lore: Unleash a flowing sequence of destructive flame attacks.
1st-2nd Strike: Fire an Ash Missile forward.
3rd Strike: Release a short-range cone-shaped Flame Shockwave.
4th Strike: Summon a medium meteor above yourself that crashes
diagonally forward, exploding on impact and leaving a cracked
burning rupture on the ground.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Volcanic Spear
lore: Summon a blazing spear and execute a rapid multi-strike combo.
1st Strike: Jab → Flaming Slash
2nd Strike: Upward Slash → Downward Slam → Final Piercing Jab
Each strike burns enemies hit.
Ignition:
The spear slightly elongates and turns dark red. Strikes deal
increased damage and gain slightly extended reach.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Hellfire Overblast
lore: Condense swirling flame energy in front of you before unleashing
a continuous fire beam for 4 seconds, scorching everything in its path.
The beam applies constant Burn damage.
Ignition:
The beam lengthens and shifts to dark crimson. Damage increases
and hit enemies are slightly knocked backward over time.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Firestorm Volley
lore: Summon multiple small fireballs that spiral upward above you,
forming a rotating sphere of flame. The sphere shatters, launching
homing fireballs that rain down toward nearby enemies.
All projectiles burn targets on impact.
Ignition:
Fireballs become dark red and explode on impact, dealing increased area damage.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Magma Dash
lore: Dash forward, tearing open the ground behind you and leaving a molten lava path.
Enemies touching the path take Burn damage over time.
Ignition:
The lava fissure darkens and destabilizes. After a short delay,
explosions erupt sequentially along the ruptured path.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Infernal Judgement
lore: Flames gather inward as the air slows. You leap upward,
igniting the ground below in a blaze eruption.
Suspended midair, multiple blazing magic circles form behind you on both sides.
From each circle, flaming spears launch forward toward your aim direction.
Each spear explodes upon impact. Finally, a massive blazing spear forms above you.
You descend diagonally with it, crashing into the ground and causing a massive rupture.
Lava and obsidian fragments erupt outward, knocking enemies
airborne and burning them heavily.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🔥 {burndamage} Burn Damage
🕗 {burnduration}s Burn Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
